title: Count Sorted Target
summary: Return how many times target occurs in a sorted list.
statement: Return how many times target occurs in a sorted list. Implement `sorted_target_count` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: Occurrence count is the width between two insertion boundaries.
Subtract lower bound from upper bound.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the sorted_target_count invariant is complete.
